title: `prometheus_remote_write` provider root schema
description: The `prometheus_remote_write` root schema comprises the entire provider databag for this interface.
$comment: `remote_write` is placed in the unit databag of every unit able to receive metrics; `alert_rules_encodings` is placed in the application databag by the leader.

remote_write.title: Remote Write
remote_write.description: Configuration of the remote write provider

url.title: URL
url.description: The URL the requirer should target with remote write operations.

alert_rules_encodings.title: Alert Rules Encodings
alert_rules_encodings.description: The encodings the provider is able to read the requirer's `alert_rules` in, most preferred first. A provider that does not publish this key is only assumed to understand `json`, so requirers must not compress their alert rules for it. Optional, for backwards compatibility with providers predating this key.

items.title: Encoding
items.description: `json` for a plain JSON object, `lzma` for an LZMA-compressed, base64-encoded JSON object.
